name: Badge
description: Views style plugin that renders rows as ID cards / badges, mapping view fields (id, photo, name, category, badge image) into a themable badge template.
project_description:
This module provides an ID Badge style plugin for Views that allows you to print ID badges such as security badges or conference badges.

 Features 
 Provides an ID Badge style plugin for Views. Includes adjustment controls per badge to modify the font size of the First Name or Last Name of the badge. Also includes a control scale the Person Image and rotate it. Use your mouse to drag over the image to crop it within the photo area. Includes an option to exclude an individual badge from printing.

 Post-Installation 
 After installation, create a new view or edit an existing view and change the format to "Badge." The "Badge" style includes options to map your fields to different parts of the ID badge.

 
 Unique ID - map to a unique ID such as the Nid to allow the badge controls to work. 
 Person Image - map to the image path for the person image. 
 First Name - map to the first name 
 Last Name - map to the last name 
 Category - map to a category that displays on the bottom of the badge 
 Badge Image - map to the image path for the background image for the entire badge 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 Requires Views module.
